posts.contentHtml:
When a new roof is to be installed in Hamilton, TX, homeowners and business owners alike often find themselves caught between two popular options: flat roof systems and traditional shingle roofs. With their own set of advantages and drawbacks, the right choice ultimately depends on your property type, design preferences, your budget, and how the roof will fare against the Texas climate.

Should you be unsure about what option will work for you, our local team of roofing contractors in Hamilton, TX can walk you through the key differences.

Flat Roof Systems Explained

  • Flat roof systems are a type of roof often found on commercial buildings, contemporary homes, and any form of architecture that prizes minimalistic design and functionality. Despite its title, a flat roof has a slight pitch for drainage purposes, but to the view of an onlooker, the roof seems pretty much flat.
  • While the flat roof offers that minimalistic, clean finish some may prefer, it also is more useful in that the rooftop can be shared as additional space, thinking of roofing patios, solar panel setups, or simply placing HVAC units.
  • But even with its appeal, flat roofs certainly present some challenges. They can pool water when improperly installed or if lacking in regular upkeep. And with Hamilton getting its share of heavy rain and heat now and then, quality material and routine inspection are what it takes for flat roofs to remain leak-free.

Shingle Roof Appeal

Shingle roofs, especially asphalt shingle roofs, are the most popular roofing systems all over America, and rightfully so. They are affordable to install and can last about 15 to 25 years with proper installation. They also give you the chance to choose from many colors and styles, so you can easily coordinate with your house's look. These roofs stand for simplicity in maintenance and roof repair, and the local roofers in Hamilton know all about shingle installation and upkeep.

So, Which One Is the Right Solution for You?

When you are talking about a prospective new roof in Hamilton, TX, a decision between flat roof systems versus shingle roofs will rest upon a few important factors:

  • Flat roofs are much more versatile and stylish for commercial buildings or modern home designs.
  • Shingles, on the other hand, have often been favored for weather resistance and classic style relating to traditional homes.
  • Budget-wise, shingles are typically less costly upfront. Flat roofs may require greater investment in materials and drainage systems.
  • Maintenance is required for both, but generally, a flat roof will require more regular inspections to catch issues related to leaking or standing water.

Regarding the Texas climate with its very hot periods and suddenly changing storms, coupled with hail, durability will be a deciding factor as well. Durability, energy efficiency, and drainage capacity should be discussed in tandem. If your current roof has already taken a hit, our team also handles storm damage and repairs in Hamilton, TX.

They will assess your property and discuss your intentions and what roofing solution will give you the best performance and peace of mind.
